description: In literal-only mode, strings in content are still templates
notes: In literal-only mode, the spec reads JSON strings as literal text. hashicorp/hcl's JSON expressions read a string as a template whenever they are given an evaluation context (expression.Value in json/structure.go), and the dynamic blocks extension evaluates the attributes of generated blocks with an evaluation context of its own (iteration.EvalContext in ext/dynblock/iteration.go), which it creates even when it was given none.
